summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing its intent to conduct an initial public offering of up to $20 million of its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a 30-day underwriter option for an additional 15%. The disclosure is a preliminary announcement of a proposed capital raise, not an actual offering document. No terms such as price per share, dividend rate, or expected closing date were stated. The filing lacks substantive deal mechanics or board recommendation details. This is a routine intention-to-offer announcement, not a special situation; watch for a subsequent prospectus filing for definitive terms.
